rebuttal_or_critique: While my conviction remains that a preemptive strike against inflation is the most prudent course to prevent the 7.44% headline print from embedding into expectations, I recognize the emerging consensus within the Committee to pause at 6.50% to assess the durability of the food price shock. Given the imperative of maintaining a unified front to anchor inflation expectations, I am willing to align with the majority on a pause in the repo rate, provided we maintain the 'withdrawal of accommodation' stance. This stance is non-negotiable; it serves as a critical signal that the MPC remains vigilant and ready to act should the supply-side shocks show signs of persistence or second-round effects.
